newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa says ex-CEO Azcarraga dies. [CORRECTED 2:41 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Televisa says ex-CEO Azcarraga dies. [CORRECTED 2:41 GMT]

text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa said on Wednesday Emilio Azcarraga Milmo, the powerful ex-chairman who recently stepped down due to ill health, had died.
The 66-year-old billionaire, who during two decades at its helm built Televisa into the Spanish speaking world's largest media firm, was believed to have suffered from a brain tumor.
Televisa, in its 24 Horas nightly bulletin, gave no details on the cause of death, but expressed its condolences.

Azcarraga resigned on March 3, to be replaced by his 29-year-old son Emilio Azcarraga Jean as president and chief executive office, and Guillermo Canedo White, as chairman and chief corporate officer.
(Corrects date of resignation and age of son).
